title: Wave 3: Observe, acquisition (after the reviews)
summary: Wave 3 of web/spec/README.md section 7 after its design, technical and science reviews were applied: Observe in the Framing and Focus task modes (D1) against the simulator. Take shot writes exactly the FITS metadata of the fixed Qt engine (80 of 80 header checks on frames saved through the UI), refuses a Light behind the Dark slot and never saves a frame exposed across a wheel move or an offset change; autofocus runs, cancels (said 'Returned' only once read back) and halts; the jog stops on key-up, blur and socket loss and keeps working after its pad is reopened. Visible fixes of the review round: the conditions plots break at intervals without frames and name them, the exposure check never blinks, the V-curve keeps its evidence once decided, one home per value in Focus mode, a stable toolbar, numbers in Mono, the jog readout in the mount's frame, less brass (jog 9 368 accent px, was 17 629). Ten scenes at 1440 x 900 in the three themes and 1280 x 800 Observatory; the Night Red originals pass the audit.

shots.caption: Observe in Framing mode with live view (simulator, M 13). Toolbar: equipment, the task modes (Field and Run unavailable), Open FITS, the Take shot split button whose face reserves the width of its widest value ('Light · 1.0 s'), Live with its frame ring, Stop, Autofocus, the zoom % kept visible. Framing band: histogram with brass black and white levels and the beyond-range count in its header row, level fields as the levels' one home (the handles carry only B, M, W), the share of pixels shown black and white, and the exposure check: the brightest clipped stars as one line, the unclipped peaks as true-length bars to 65 535 with linearity and full-well marks, a 'this frame' stamp. Camera card without a progress row (Sensor °C, Format); Mount card with Tracking as a neutral toggle and Slew secondary (the fields hold the current target). (observatory, 1440x900.)

Jog with the server dead-man: J armed the arrow keys (brass pad edge), East held (brass key), the dead-man meter renewed every 250 ms. On this equatorial mount the offset readout follows the key words, ΔRA as time (+6m52s) and ΔDec in arcminutes, and the scope draws east to the right with a scale that grows (±2°, ±10°, ±45°). The Mount card says '1.38° away' in words; Slew stays secondary during the jog. (observatory, 1440x900.)
